horizontal_error_definition: largest horizontal distance from the best node to any grid node with RMS <= best RMS + 0.1 s
location_method: grid search, homogeneous Vp 6.0 km/s and Vs 3.46 km/s, station elevations; lat/lon +/- 0.5 deg in 0.01 deg, depth 0-20 km in 0.5 km; origin = mean residual (code/locate.py)

magnitude.rule: M_cons = min(M_rel, Wood-Anderson ML calibrated, M_coloc)
magnitude.wa_method: response removed to displacement (pre-filter 0.5/1/25/40 Hz), Wood-Anderson simulated (poles -6.283+/-4.7124i, zeros 0,0, gain 2080); A = mean of the live horizontals' peak |amplitude| (mm; a constant channel is skipped: NN.YER..HHE is flat after the mainshock) in [P - 0.5 s, S + 4 s] (picked times, else predicted); station ML = log10 A + 1.11 log10(r/100) + 0.00189 (r - 100) + 3.0 (Hutton and Boore 1987); event ML = median over stations
magnitude.coloc_method: up to 10 ComCat ml events of the same UTC day within 5 km of the epicentre (nearest first): M_i + median over common stations of log10(A_cand / A_i), A as in wa_method with predicted P/S times for the ComCat events; then the median over events
magnitude.M_rel_method: detecting template's ComCat ml + log10(median RMS ratio of detection to template windows, 2-8 Hz, 20 Hz)
magnitude.computed_by: code/mag_check.py compute (event windows in data/, data/evwin/; writes mag_check_out.json)

detection.detection_threshold: 9 x MAD of the template-day NCC
detection.station_cc_note: Pearson CC at the exact aligned lag (float64; code/null_full.py and a direct float64 check agree to < 1e-11); NCC = their mean
detection.templates: 385 of the 415 ComCat events within 20 km of the mainshock epicentre in the search span (30 dropped for fewer than 3 stations at SNR >= 3); data/templates.json
